data.title: 久岛鸥 · 白色灯塔旋梯的水手回眸
data.description: 鸟白岛洁白灯塔外的螺旋石阶上，海风阵阵。鸥一手扶着水手裙摆，一手按住水手帽子，在阶梯中央停步回首，展露无忧无虑的俏皮笑颜。
data.location: spiral stone staircase encircling a pristine white seaside lighthouse
data.action: paused mid-step on lighthouse spiral stairs, holding sailor cap with one hand while turning back with an energetic playful grin
data.lighting: 纯白灯塔漫射日光与蔚蓝晴空
data.promptProse: Kamome pauses on the white lighthouse steps, looking back with a bright, mischievous grin against the summer blue sky.
data.animaCaption: Ocean wind whips around her as she pauses on the lighthouse stairs with a sunny grin.
